Quellalpin Kaunertal

30° warm, quality-tested Tyrolean spring water awaits guests at Quellalpin Kaunertal. Further highlights: Adventure pool with whirlpool loungers, massage jets, neck shower, toddler area with baby pool and a spacious sauna area on the roof with panoramic mountain views.

Description

The Quellalpin Kaunertal touches with the power of the nature park and glacier region. In the swimming pool and in the sauna area on the roof of the building with a view of the surrounding mountains, it is easy to immerse yourself in a nature-related wellness experience. Wood, granite, hay and that with the seal of quality excellent spring water characterise the style and ambience of the leisure facility.

The restaurant with traditional down to earth cuisine, the fitness studio, the beach volleyball court, the tennis court, the bowling alley, the shooting range and the Kaunertal Saal complete the offer and offer numerous opportunities for joint activities.
